mainEntity.name: Is Annura AI really free compared to MyFitnessPal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. During our Google Play Closed Testing phase, all core features—including AI photo meal logging, barcode scanning, additive analysis, intermittent fasting timers, and Annura AI Chat—are completely free. MyFitnessPal charges $19.99/month or $79.99/year for comparable premium features like barcode scanning and fasting.

mainEntity.name: Can Annura AI estimate portion sizes from a single photo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Annura uses advanced computer vision trained on culinary volume benchmarks to estimate plate proportions, ingredients, and total macronutrients. You can also adjust portions manually with a single tap if you prefer exact measurements.

mainEntity.name: Does Annura AI have a barcode scanner?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Annura integrates directly with the Open Food Facts global database. Scanning packaged foods provides instant macros, plus an automated purity breakdown highlighting harmful additives, allergens, and excessive processing.

mainEntity.name: Is Annura AI available on iOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, Annura AI is available exclusively for Android devices via the Google Play Store closed beta. An iOS version is actively in development.

mainEntity.name: How does Annura AI protect my health data compared to MyFitnessPal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlike ad-monetized fitness platforms, Annura AI operates as a secure private vault. Your health records, logged photos, and conversation history are encrypted and will never be sold to brokers, advertisers, or insurance providers.
